newsitem.title: UK: Commercial Union rebounds after recent fall.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Union rebounds after recent fall.

text.p: Shares in Commercial Union Plc were the biggest gainers in the FTSE 100 index late afternoon on Friday, as buyers returned to the stock after its recent sharp falls, dealers said.
"It had a tremendous fall and it got whacked this morning, and ever since then there have been buyers," said one market maker in the shares. "The fall was completely overdone."
The stock was up 24p, or 3.7 percent, at 665 by 1607 GMT in volume of 3.9 million shares, after earlier plummeting to a four-month low of 633p.
Insurance and other financial stocks have been major casualties this week amid fears of a squeeze from rising interest rates.
CU has been among the biggest decliners among composite insurers with a 9.5 percent drop by yesterday's close.
Dealers pointed out that bid speculation has buoyed CU in the past and could still be underpinning the stock.
